title: ARahim3/DigUp
why_read: An on-device semantic search tool for Mac files using a local embedding model is a practical and privacy-respecting application of recent small-model embedding research.
analysis: DigUp lets users search their Mac's files, including photos, PDFs, recordings, and code, by meaning rather than exact filename or text match, using Google DeepMind's EmbeddingGemma model running entirely on-device. This matters because it avoids sending personal data to the cloud while still getting semantic search quality that previously required large server-side models. The use of a small, efficient embedding model for multimodal local search reflects a broader trend of shrinking powerful models down for consumer hardware. It's a solid practical demonstration of applied embedding model technology rather than a research contribution itself.
